task: binary triage: refer (suspicious, needs specialist) vs no_refer

input.name: input
preprocessing: decode image, apply EXIF orientation, convert to RGB
letterbox: resize longest side to 224 keeping aspect ratio (INTER_AREA when shrinking)
pad to 224x224, image centred, pad colour RGB [124, 116, 104]
scale to [0,1], subtract mean, divide by std (per channel)

outputs_full_model.prob: float32 [batch] calibrated probability of 'refer' (Platt calibration applied)
outputs_full_model.embedding: float32 [batch, 1280] pooled features (use L2-normalised for similarity search)
outputs_full_model.cam: float32 [batch, 7, 7] heat map in [0,1]; upsample to image size

meaning.screening: default operating point; tuned on calibration data to reach the target sensitivity
meaning.balanced: maximises balanced accuracy on calibration data

decision.per_person_score: maximum prob across the 6 mouth sites

disclaimer: Screening decision-support aid only. Not a diagnostic device.
